lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ce2Al4Pb2 (CeAl2Pb) is orthorhombic, space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 8 atoms per unit cell distributed over 4 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al centers with 10 neighbors (6 Al, 2 Ce, 2 Pb) and Ce centers with 14 neighbors (4 Al, 10 Pb), while Pb centers have 7 Al neighbors. The neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 8 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis indicates corner- and edge-sharing between Al 10-vertex and Pb 7-vertex polyhedra, with Al–Al polyhedra also showing corner, edge, and face contacts.
